subject: planner: bound the max out of range estimate (#65888)
summary: Reviewed diff vs parent: main behavior change is in `pkg/statistics/histogram.go` (`Histogram.OutOfRangeRowCount`) to cap out-of-range `MaxEst` by scaling worst-case added rows with predicate overlap (`maxTotalPercent`), plus some robustness tweaks (NDV/oneValue handling, unsigned negative-only ranges, predWidth==0 handling).
